description: Reservatório de água is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by APIN - Empresa Intermunicipal de Ambiente do Pinhal Interior, S.A.. This dataset contains geospatial information on water supply reservoirs, which are facilities responsible for storing drinking and drinking water. The dataset includes the location as well as other information fields that help characterize each reservoir. These data can inform water network management and planning for continuity and efficiency of supply. Coverage: APIN - Empresa Intermunicipal de Ambiente do Pinhal Interior, S.A.. The portal shows the English title as "Water reservoir" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is APIN - Empresa Intermunicipal de Ambiente do Pinhal Interior, S.A.. Its keywords include reservatorio-de-agua, armazenamento-de-agua, infraestrutura-hidraulica, sistema-de-abastecimento-de-agua, abastecimento-de-agua. The listing shows 2 download or service links in JSON, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2026-08-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
